# Digital Transition Marketing (DTM)

## Internal SOP — AI Automation & AI Agents

**System Owner: Neon Vision**
**Phase: Leverage & Launch**

---

## 1. PURPOSE

This SOP governs how Digital Transition Marketing designs, deploys, monitors, and scales **AI Automation Systems and AI Agents** across all client tiers.

This document is **execution-focused**. No experimentation occurs in live client environments without Neon Vision authorization.

---

## 2. SCOPE

This SOP applies to:

* Client-facing AI agents
* Internal automation agents
* Workflow orchestration (n8n / Make)
* CRM, email, analytics, and ops automations
* Multi-agent systems

Excluded:

* Model research
* Tool experimentation outside sandbox

---

## 3. ROLE DEFINITIONS

### AI Systems Architect

* Designs agent logic
* Defines system boundaries
* Approves production deployment

### Automation Engineer

* Builds workflows
* Connects APIs
* Implements safeguards

### Sales Operator

* Collects requirements
* Validates bus
